retrievalProfile.description: A bright, high-key ensemble composition featuring a line of joyful characters against a sparkling sea, topped with ultra-condensed serif display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A horizontal row of expressive characters in light summer attire performing varied, joyful dance-like poses on a stone terrace, set against a bright blue ocean and sky, with a heavy typographic header featuring vertical gradients.
coreVisualRelationships: Characters anchored to a low stone wall at the bottom third
Typographic header occupying the top third of the frame
Vibrant blue sea providing a high-contrast background for the cast
Scattered pink petals on the ground connecting the figures
coreInvariants: Blue-to-white vertical gradient in main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body ensemble cast arranged horizontally across the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central character in a dynamic kicking pose acts as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the large top title down to the central figures, then scans horizontally across the expressive poses.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the sky area to accommodate the large display typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright Sky Blue (Background and Title Gradient)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, medium saturation; creates a clean, airy, and optimistic atmosphere.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid heavy blacks or muddy earth tones

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick verticals and hair-line horizontals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exclamation point is oversized and integrated into the baseline
Vertical blue-to-white linear gradient applied to the fill
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme vertical serif for impact paired with a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Scattered organic elements (petals) to break the rigid horizontal line

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the extreme verticality and high contrast of the main title.
Provides a clean, classic contrast for the secondary information.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key photograph of an ensemble cast in summer clothing (linen, sundresses) posing joyfully on a white stone terrace overlooking a sparkling blue Mediterranean sea under a clear sky. Leave the top third of the frame as empty sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in an ultra-condensed serif font with a blue-to-white vertical gradient. Place secondary text in a dark navy sans-serif below it, using wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-key and sun-drenched?
Does the main title have a vertical blue gradient?
Are the characters arranged in a horizontal line?
Is the terrace floor scattered with pink petals?

adjustableVariables: Number of characters in the ensemble
Vertical stretch of the display font
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the sky
Check that the horizon line is straight
Verify the gradient direction is vertical
Confirm the cast looks cohesive in style and lighting
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble cast + Mediterranean terrace + Ultra-condensed gradient serif = Summer Musical Aesthetic
